definitions.explanation: The dried or fresh leaves of the tea plant used to brew tea. Refers to the leaves themselves rather than the prepared beverage.

examples.japanese: {茶葉|ちゃば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Put the tea leaves in the teapot.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{茶葉|ちゃば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{静岡|しずおか}{産|さん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上質|じょうしつ}→上質：20493_joushitsu⟧なものだ。
examples.english: These tea leaves are high-quality ones from Shizuoka.

examples.japanese: {茶葉|ちゃば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧や⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The flavor changes greatly depending on the amount of tea leaves and the water temperature.

notes:
{茶葉|ちゃば} refers to tea leaves — the dried or fresh leaves of the tea plant, used to brew tea. A compound of ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea) + {葉|ば} (leaf).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶葉|ちゃば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧: to steam tea leaves
- {茶葉|ちゃば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧: tea-producing region
- ⟦{上質|じょうしつ}→上質：20493_joushitsu⟧な{茶葉|ちゃば}: high-quality tea leaves
- {茶葉|ちゃば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to store tea leaves
- {茶葉|ちゃば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put tea leaves in the teapot

USAGE:
Used when discussing tea varieties, preparation methods, or purchasing. Major tea-producing regions in Japan include {静岡|しずおか}, ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧ ({宇治|うじ}), and {鹿児島|かごしま}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茶葉|ちゃば}: the leaves themselves (raw material)
- ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧: the prepared beverage, or tea in general
